answer: The ripple index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 866 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the comet queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 315 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
